title: Sandro Marcos will provide stability to Lakas-CMD — Khonghun
summary: House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos’s move to join Lakas-CMD is seen to provide “stability” to the party, according to one of its members, House Deputy Speaker Jefferson Khonghun.
